name: Иконки ресурсов сеткой — цикл I. Слово автора: «Иконки по ресурсам начинай генерировать только тогда, когда придёт с отчётом Этрион». Собирает tools/art-gen/res_jobs.py из design/ui/recipes.js — руками не править

plan.Язык иконки: один предмет в покое на тёмном камне, три четверти сверху, узнаваемая форма читается на 32 px; вид предмета различает рамка интерфейса (CR_KIND и CR_FAM, screens/crafthall.js), редкость — свет в окне рамки
plan.Палитра: цвет карста цикла, свет снизу — его же: The palette of this sheet: pale white-green crystal light (#DFF4E5), light pale wood, warm grey clay and pale moss. The light from below is a soft pale white-green glow — never saturated teal.
plan.Листы: листы Этриона (поле sheet) переупакованы внутри цикла по 20 клеток, остаток — малым листом; предметы с img и герои не рисуются

notes: cells — [id предмета EN_RECIPES.items, имя файла]; spare — пустая клетка малого листа, не выгружается; hidden — «ресурс скрыт»

Проба 30.09.2026 — res-P-1 и res-I-1 — нарисована с предметом на две трети клетки: в рамке вида окно — 72 % колодца, предмет выходил мелким на 32 px. С остальных листов предмет — на три четверти клетки
Фраза облика — поле art Этриона; письмо, руны и цифры переписаны в неразборчивые штрихи (FIX в res_jobs.py)
Слабые клетки — надписи, пентаграмма, «летающая тарелка», светлый фон — перерисованы листами res-fix-* (jobs/res-icons-fix.json): их клетка заменяет клетку этого листа

Листы res-I-2…res-I-6 вышли с насыщенным мятным конусом света — как зелень цикла V, а палитра цикла I — «белый с прозеленью». Мята приглушена без новой генерации: python tools/art-gen/hue_fix.py "art/generated/res-icons/res-I-*/cells.json" (полоса 125–190°, насыщенность × 0,25, яркость × 0,92; клетки, где полосы больше 4 %) — 64 клетки получили <имя>.fix.webp
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold and warm light contrast. Dust motes and grains of sand float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images, but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no captions, titles or labels under, over or inside the icons, no real-world alphabets, no runes or marks that look like writing, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no frames or borders drawn inside the cells. No pentagrams, no occult signs. No magenta or pink anywhere inside the icons: magenta appears only in the gutters.

res-icons.frame: Format: a sheet of square item icons for a mobile RPG, painted together as one consistent set. The icons stand in a precise grid of equal square cells; the number of columns and rows and the item in every cell are listed below, row by row from the top, each row from left to right. Between the cells run narrow straight gutters of flat, uniform pure magenta (#FF00FF), and the same magenta gutter runs around the outside of the whole grid. All gutters have the same width, all cells have the same size, and nothing crosses a gutter. Every cell is its own complete square painting filled from edge to edge — the game lays its own frame over the edges of the cell, so everything important stays in the middle. Every cell shows exactly one item — a raw material, a trophy, a crafted piece or a relic — lying or standing still on dark near-black stone with faint cracks and a darker vignette toward the edges of the cell: one clear central object, large, filling about three quarters of the cell, in a clear three-quarter view from slightly above, with a bold recognisable silhouette that reads at 32 px. When a cell names several things, the first one is the main object — large and centred — and the others are small details beside it. Light rises from below in the colour of this sheet's palette, a soft glow from cracks in the stone — never a spotlight; crisp rim light on the edges of the object; a few dust motes in the light. Painted exactly like the ability icons of this game: loose, confident painterly brush strokes, soft painted edges and deep shadows — no black outlines, no flat sticker look, no scenery, no hands or people unless the cell names them. Writing is never drawn: wherever a cell mentions script, notes, pages, maps, tallies, tags or marks, they are faint unreadable smudges and straight ruled lines; clock faces and dials are plain, with simple notches and no numerals. All icons share the same brushwork, lighting, level of detail and palette, so they read as one set, and each differs clearly from its neighbours.

jobs.title: Ресурсы, цикл I — лист 1: 20 иконок сеткой 5×4
jobs.source: design/ui/recipes.js (EN_RECIPES.items: поле art), листы Этриона I-01
jobs.subject:
The palette of this sheet: pale white-green crystal light (#DFF4E5), light pale wood, warm grey clay and pale moss. The light from below is a soft pale white-green glow — never saturated teal.

The grid: exactly 5 columns and 4 rows, 20 icons.

Row 1: A fan of thin curved steel blades joined at a bone hilt, edges catching a pale green glint; A long bone needle shaped like a slender finger, threaded with amber cord, clay dust on the tip; A square grey stone slab with a carved round mark, chipped corners and dried clay smears; A lump of warm reddish clay with finger marks, a thin curl of steam, faint ember glow inside; A pale clay mask with empty eye holes, a faint face imprint inside, cracked at the chin.

Row 2: A bronze bellows nozzle with a flared mouth, soot-blackened, a faint orange glow at its tip; A small grey clay hand with delicate curled fingers, a seam at the wrist where it was pressed onto a larger body; A small clay hand half-sunk into a lump of warm red clay, faint steam and ember glow around the wrist; A half-finished clay figure on a wire armature, one small hand attached, green crystal chips set in its chest; A single deep groove carved across a slab of dried clay, glowing faint white-green along its length.

Row 3: A curved hunting horn of pale antler bound with bark strips, a soft green glow at its mouth; A coiled ribbon of pale bark fibre, faintly luminous, loose threads at both ends; A springy forked branch of pale smooth wood, bound at one end with bark; A broad translucent leaf glowing cold white-green from within, its veins bright like frost; A small heap of white-green crystal grains glowing softly on dark cloth.

Row 4: A gnarled root threaded with rusty ore veins, earth still clinging, a dull metallic sheen; A thick lock of silver-green fur tied with a knot of root fibre, faintly glowing at the tips; A lock of silver-green fur wrapped in white thread charms and small claws, glowing softly; A large antler horn wrapped with fur and white charms, a tiny ringed white city carved on its bell; A tiny milk tooth of a beast cub on a braided grass cord, pale green glow at its root.
